FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
EcoClean Laundry Services specializes in providing high-quality dry cleaning and laundry services to residential and commercial clients. Our operations focus on using environmentally friendly cleaning solvents and practices to ensure the safety of both our customers and the environment. We offer a range of services including clothing alterations, pressing, and repairs, alongside our main laundry and dry cleaning operations. 

Our facility features state-of-the-art equipment that is regularly maintained, ensuring optimal performance and compliance with safety regulations. We maintain detailed records of all equipment maintenance for transparency and adherence to operational standards. Our commitment to customer service includes sponsored programs for local organizations and clubs, as well as partnerships with hotels and restaurants that require regular laundry services.

We strictly comply with all local, state, and federal environmental regulations regarding chemical use and disposal, emphasizing safety in every aspect of our operations. Our hours of operation are designed to accommodate our clients' needs, providing reliable and convenient service. Overall, EcoClean Laundry Services aims to deliver exceptional quality while upholding the highest standards of cleanliness and safety.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Clothing alteration and repair services in addition to laundry operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred between January 10, 2023, and February 5, 2023, primarily due to equipment malfunction, leading to a loss of $15,000 related to client garment damage. The status is currently resolved as the insured covered the damages to affected clients.
